findings.title: Team admin check uses `&&` instead of `||`, blocking team admins from adding guests
findings.body: `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`. Because `isTeamAdmin` checks for `ADMIN` or `OWNER` role while `isTeamOwner` checks strictly for `OWNER`, using `&&` means the expression is only true when the user is a team owner, and always false for a team admin who is not an owner. It should use `||` (or simply `await isTeamAdmin(...)` if that helper already includes owners) so team admins have permission as intended by the variable name.

findings.title: Calendar update uses the caller's credentials instead of the booking organizer's credentials
findings.body: `addGuestsHandler` allows an attendee or a team admin/owner (who is not the booking organizer) to add guests to a booking. However, on lines 158-163 it fetches credentials for `ctx.user` (the logged-in caller) and constructs `EventManager` with `user` instead of `booking.user` (the organizer). When an attendee or team admin adds guests, `EventManager.updateCalendarAttendees` will lack the organizer's calendar credentials and fail to update the actual calendar event on the organizer's external calendar.

findings.title: Duplicate guest emails in request input and case differences bypass deduplication and blacklist checks
findings.body: `uniqueGuests` only filters against existing `booking.attendees` and `blacklistedGuestEmails`, without deduplicating the incoming `guests` array itself or normalizing email case. If a client calls the tRPC endpoint directly with duplicate emails in `guests` (e.g. `['a@b.com', 'a@b.com']`), or with uppercase characters that bypass `blacklistedGuestEmails` (which was lowercased on line 71, while `guest` is not lowercased on line 77) or existing attendees with different casing, duplicate attendee records will be created in the database and blacklisted addresses will not be filtered.

findings.title: Guests can be added to cancelled, rejected, or past bookings
findings.body: In `BookingListItem.tsx`, `editBookingActions` (including `add_members`) is rendered for past confirmed bookings (`isBookingInPast && isConfirmed` on line 554) and `addGuestsHandler` does not check `booking.status` or whether the booking has already ended. As a result, users can add guests to past, cancelled, or rejected bookings, triggering calendar updates and 'Guests Added' / 'Scheduled' emails for events that are no longer active.

findings.title: `sendAddGuestsEmails` ignores `disableStandardEmails` metadata settings
findings.body: Unlike `sendScheduledEmails`, `sendRescheduledEmails`, and `sendLocationChangeEmails` in `packages/emails/email-manager.ts`, `sendAddGuestsEmails` does not accept `eventTypeMetadata` or check `eventTypeDisableHostEmail` / `eventTypeDisableAttendeeEmail`. Bookings on event types configured to suppress standard host or attendee emails will still send emails to the organizer and all attendees when guests are added.
